title: Turkish-Style Chicken Kebap
description: A flavorful and spicy kebab dish originating from Turkey, perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together pecan oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and mix well to coat.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cook the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Sprinkle with chopped pecans and serve immediately.
